Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :CTRL.newchpid IS NULL THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('0080', '- Chapter ID');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;

IF :CTRL.newwhid IS NULL THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('0080', '- Warehouse ID');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;


IF :CTRL.NEWCHPID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :CTRL.NEWCHPID <> :CTRL.CHPID THEN -- update chapter id if the new chapter ID is different from current chapter ID.
 /* MLT 242 (Do not update system users - it should be default chapter ID) 
 UPDATE system_users
 SET chapter_id = :CTRL.NEWCHPID
 WHERE user_id = lt_user_session.get_userID;
 */
 
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id := :CTRL.NEWCHPID;
 :GLOBAL.label_printer := NULL; -- IM 715
 -- Set lt_user_session variables. -- LT2018
 set_user_session;
 
 -- Set user access class;
 UPDATE valid_user_access_classes 
 SET CHAPTER_ID=:ctrl.newchpid
 WHERE USER_ID= lt_user_session.get_userID;
 
 show_error('7035', ' - ' || :ctrl.newchpid);
 check_package_failure; 

 END IF;
END IF;

IF :CTRL.NEWWHID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.warehouse := :CTRL.NEWWHID;
 lt_user_session.set_warehouse_id(:GLOBAL.warehouse);
 
 :GLOBAL.label_printer := NULL; -- IM 715
 
 /* -- V02 changes
 -- Commented below code on 01/18/2017
 -- warehouse ID in system_users table is used as a default warehouse.
 -- we do not want to update it everytime the change chapter is invoked.
 -- default warehouse can be modified only in add user screen.
 BEGIN
 update system_users 
 set warehouse_id = :CTRL.NEWWHID
 -- print_id = nvl(:valid_warehouse_users.printer_id, print_id)
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
 EXCEPTION
 when others then 
 null;
 END;
 */
END IF;

:system.message_level := 5;
commit;
:system.message_level := 0;


 -- Added on 02/16/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 declare
 v_local_time date;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :banner.hdr_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :banner.hdr_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;

 --:banner.prog_version:='Rel: ' ||:global.program_version; -- LT 2018
 -- LT 2018
 DECLARE
 l_warehouse VARCHAR2(20) := NULL;
 BEGIN 
 IF :global.warehouse IS NOT NULL THEN
 l_warehouse := ' [' || :global.warehouse || ']';
 END IF;
 
 :banner.prog_version:='Rel: ' ||:global.program_version 
 || ' ' || :global.chapter_id || l_warehouse;
 END; 

CLEAR_FORM;
exit_form;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 recNo INTEGER;
BEGIN
 -- Store the checked record number.
 recNo := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 
IF :valid_user_chapters.s_chp_chk = 'Y' THEN
 IF :ctrl.chprecno IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- Go to the previous checked record and uncheck it.
 GO_RECORD(:ctrl.chprecno);
 :valid_user_chapters.s_chp_chk := 'N';
 END IF;
 -- Come back to current checked record number and
 -- store the current checked record and set the new chapter ID display
 GO_RECORD(recNo);
 :ctrl.chprecno := recNo;
 :ctrl.newchpid := :valid_user_chapters.chapter_id;
 
 :ctrl.def_whid := default_whid; -- MLT 410
 
 -- Reset the new warehouseID display to null, and query the warehouse-users table.
 :ctrl.newwhid := NULL; -- reset the new warehouse ID.
 :ctrl.whrecno := NULL; -- reset the record number;
 GO_BLOCK('valid_warehouse_users');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;

ELSE
 -- Reset the new warehouseID display to null, and query the warehouse-users table.
 :ctrl.newwhid := NULL; -- reset the new warehouse ID.
 :ctrl.whrecno := NULL; -- reset the record number;
 GO_BLOCK('valid_warehouse_users');
 CLEAR_BLOCK;
 GO_BLOCK('valid_user_chapters');
 GO_RECORD(recNo);
 :ctrl.newchpid := NULL;
 :ctrl.chprecno := NULL;
 
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 recNo INTEGER;
BEGIN

 IF :valid_warehouse_users.s_wh_chk = 'Y' THEN
 -- Store the current checked record number
 recNo := :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD;
 
 IF :ctrl.whrecno IS NOT NULL THEN 
 -- Go to previous checked record number and uncheck it.
 GO_RECORD(:ctrl.whrecno);
 :valid_warehouse_users.s_wh_chk := 'N';
 -- Go back to the current checked record.
 GO_RECORD(recNo);
 END IF;
 
 -- Store the current checked record number and set the display of new warehouse ID
 :ctrl.whrecno := recNo; 
 :ctrl.newwhid := :valid_warehouse_users.warehouse_id;
 ELSE
 :ctrl.whrecno := NULL; 
 :ctrl.newwhid := NULL; 
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc 
 into :valid_warehouse_users.s_wh_desc 
 FROM vserv_master
 WHERE code_type = 'LTYPE'
 AND code = :valid_warehouse_users.warehouse_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 
 -- For current chapter ID and warehouse ID, 
 IF :valid_warehouse_users.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND :valid_warehouse_users.warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse THEN
 :valid_warehouse_users.s_wh_chk := 'Y'; -- keep the checkmark selected for current warehouse ID.
 :ctrl.whrecno := :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD; ---- Store the current record to be used later for checking-unchecking of checkbox..
 :ctrl.newwhid := :GLOBAL.warehouse; -- Set the new warehouseID display.
 -- MLT 410 (elsif added)
 ELSIF :valid_warehouse_users.chapter_id <> :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND :valid_warehouse_users.warehouse_id = :ctrl.def_whid THEN
 :valid_warehouse_users.s_wh_chk := 'Y'; -- keep the checkmark selected for current warehouse ID.
 :ctrl.whrecno := :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD; ---- Store the current record to be used later for checking-unchecking of checkbox..
 :ctrl.newwhid := :ctrl.def_whid; -- MLT 1629 -- Set the new warehouseID display. 
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS

BEGIN

 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- V02
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 414 (block where clauses modified to not show terminated chapter and warehouse)

 -- V03 -- IM 414; ctrl.chp_sysdate used in block where clause.
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN

/*

 */

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_USER_SESSION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_USER_SESSION IS
BEGIN
 -- took set_appl_global routine from logins screen and made changes.
 -- Assigning :GLOBAL.tz_offset and lt_user_session variables(chapter_id and tz_offset)
 
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset := '';
 
 -- global.tz_offset variable is set here.
 begin
 /* MLT 242
 select ch.time_zone 
 into :GLOBAL.tz_offset
 from system_users su, chapters ch
 where UPPER(su.user_id) = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid and
 su.chapter_id = ch.chapter_id and
 sysdate between ch.eff_date and nvl(ch.term_date,sysdate+365);
 */
 -- MLT 242
 select ch.time_zone
 into :GLOBAL.tz_offset
 from chapters ch
 where ch.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id -- (GLOBAL has the new chapter ID)
 and sysdate between ch.eff_date and nvl(ch.term_date, sysdate + 365);
 -----------
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting chapter_id for user');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 
 
 -- Set lt_user_session variables. -- LT2018
 lt_user_session.set_chapter_id(:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 lt_user_session.set_tzone_offset(:GLOBAL.tz_offset);
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DEFAULT_WHID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION default_whid RETURN VARCHAR2 IS -- MLT 410
 CURSOR def_whid_cur is
 SELECT warehouse_id
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = lt_user_session.get_userid;
 
 l_def_whid VARCHAR2(1); 
BEGIN
 -- get the default warehouse id for the user.

 OPEN def_whid_cur;
 FETCH def_whid_cur INTO l_def_whid;
 CLOSE def_whid_cur;

 RETURN l_def_whid;
END;
